who_can_apply: Eligible if: 3 or more G3 passes and not qualify for JC, MI or polytechnic diploma; or 2 or fewer G3 passes and gross ELMAB3 <= 21, ELB3 <= 14 or MAB3 <= 14 computed at G2 (at least Grade 5 at G2 for all subjects used). Only students with gross ELMAB3 <= 19 can offer all subjects at G3 in the 5th year.
institutions: Secondary school (Sec 5)
aggregate_types: ELMAB3 / ELB3 / MAB3 at G2 (see who_can_apply)
